what: SHA-256 of the six reference files written by loomora_refgen (basic, empty, escape40, multi, multi-light, one). Reference = the six hashes of the golden constants of core/tests/format_selftest.cpp, held once in the files stored under validation/evidence/adr-0021/windows-11-x64/. Files byte-identical to the reference are not stored again (ADR 0014); only their hash is recorded here.
platform_note: NOT RUN ON WINDOWS 2000. The programs are built for the Windows 2000 target (cmake/toolchains/mingw-w64-win2000-i686.cmake, _WIN32_WINNT=0x0500) and were run as 32-bit processes on Windows 11 x64. The VirtualBox VM of validation/platforms/windows-2000-x86.json was not started for spec 002 (not_tested): this proves bytes and logic, not the Windows 2000 loader, kernel32 or msvcrt.

runs.toolchain: cmake/toolchains/mingw-w64-win2000-i686.cmake (_WIN32_WINNT=0x0500, LOOMORA_TARGET_WIN2000, msvcrt, static libgcc and libstdc++, GetThreadId and condition variable shim linked in), LOOMORA_TEST_FP_FLAGS = -msse2 -mfpmath=sse
